summary: Completed testing of salon booking app blacklist and daily limit fixes. Blacklist functionality is partially working with phone normalization issues. Daily limit (max 3 reservations per phone per day) is still completely broken. Frontend booking flow and admin dashboard work correctly.

critical_bugs.issue: Daily limit (max 3 reservations per phone per day) not enforced
critical_bugs.impact: Business rule violation - customers can exceed daily booking limits
critical_bugs.details: 4th reservation with same normalized phone was allowed (expected 400, got 200). Phone normalization works but daily counting logic is broken.

major_bugs.issue: Phone normalization incomplete for local formats
major_bugs.impact: Blacklist can be bypassed using local phone formats
major_bugs.details: Formats like '0611111111', '611111111', '061-111-1111' are not being normalized properly, allowing blacklisted users to bypass restrictions

minor_issues.impact: Some bookings fail with 'Izabrani termin više nije dostupan'
minor_issues.details: Intermittent conflicts during concurrent booking attempts

integration_issues.issue: Admin dashboard shows reservations correctly but requires manual date navigation
integration_issues.details: Admin can see reservations but needs to navigate to correct date. Default view shows today's date.

passed_tests: Frontend booking flow (4-step process works perfectly)
Blacklist functionality for international phone formats (+381...)

critical_fixes: Fix daily limit enforcement - max 3 reservations per phone per day is completely broken
Complete phone normalization implementation for local formats (0611111111, 061-111-1111, etc.)
Debug reservation counting logic in daily limit validation
investigation_needed: Review normalize_phone() function to handle all Serbian phone formats
Check daily reservation counting query in create_reservation endpoint
Verify blacklist phone matching logic for all normalized formats
